content.short: Web3Auth provides a self-custodial wallet-as-a-service powered by MPC.
content.description: Web3Auth addresses the onboarding and key management challenge by leveraging multi-party computation (MPC) technology. Rather than relying on seed phrases, users sign in with familiar social accounts, enabling the creation of non-custodial wallets with one-click login. In addition, two-factor wallet architectures provide recovery paths that help users regain access without risking loss of private keys, making self-custody more practical and resilient across supported networks.
content.meta: Web3Auth uses multi-party computation (MPC) to power a self-custodial wallet-as-a-service. Discover Web3Auth and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
